name: meanTimeToVerificationAckMinutesCount
definition: Mean minutes from an alert's creation to the MDR's analysts verifying it and handing it to the customer's organization, over the incidents the MDR actually monitors.
population: the SOC-monitored incidents the connected managed-detection tenant lists that carry both a creation and an organization-assignment time
evidenceRequiredForTrue: At least one SOC-monitored incident with both timestamps. Incidents the MDR marks as not monitored (tuning) or customer-monitored, and incidents the platform auto-routed by rule (is_autorouted), are excluded, because their assignment time is the auto-router's, not an analyst's. No such incident, no incidents, or an error or refused answer is not measured.
